item.coloph: zhes pa'i ngo sprod sangs rgyas lag 'chang 'di/ skyang nam ming gis bsam sbyor dag pa yis/ rang gi nyams dang bka' lung snying po bsdus / ma rtogs sems can don du brtse bas bkod/ 'gal ba'i nor 'khrul mchis na mthol lo bshags/ dge ba'i 'bras su thar pa'i lam mchog tu/ 'gro kun bgrod pa'i gsos su 'byung bar shog/
